notes: ὁ ἡγούμενος τοῦ λόγου is split as the / chief / speaker under rule 2, each token's English staying recoverable; giving chief speaker whole to the participle and emptying λόγου remains defensible and is named in the unit's note.
The inner τοῦ is unrepresented under rules 21 and 23, the ASV writing neither a determiner nor an of for speaker.
The ASV renders Δία and Ἑρμῆν by Jupiter and Mercury, its own gloss notes recording the Greek; both are ordinary aligned units.
